name: Jacob Rottenberg
headline: Founder @ Ezcloud | Custom Software | eCommerce | Consulting
about:
Jacob is a builder, problem-solver, and systems thinker with over 15 years of experience in operations leadership and custom software development. His expertise lies in transforming complex, often chaotic business challenges into simple, scalable solutions.

His career began with large-scale operational roles - managing nonprofit infrastructure, coordinating youth programs for 1,000+ participants, and supervising fast-paced retail teams. These early experiences shaped his ability to understand systems holistically and solve problems under pressure.

In 2013, Jacob founded ezcloud, a custom software company focused on creating tailored tools that help businesses streamline operations, reduce friction, and scale effectively. From pricing automation tools to workflow optimizers and custom integrations, Jacob has built solutions that are used by hundreds of businesses across industries.

He has led projects such as:
 • Designing dynamic pricing engines that adapt to volatile markets
 • Automating complex, multi-source inventory processes
 • Streamlining approval flows and internal operations for scaling teams
 • Helping clients uncover hidden inefficiencies and turn them into product features

One of Jacob’s greatest strengths is helping clients define problems they can’t quite explain. He bridges the gap between business reality and technical execution — building systems that don’t just “function,” but empower people to work better.

In consulting and systems design, speed and clarity matter. Jacob is often able to map out a business’s core structure within a single session - spotting inefficiencies and opportunities that others overlook. This fast, intuitive grasp of operations builds momentum and trust, setting the stage for real results from the very beginning.

experiences.description: At Ezcloud, I spearheaded the creation of a comprehensive software service tailored for eCommerce sellers, focusing on customized solutions that drive business success. By fostering strong client relationships, I ensured our offerings met their unique needs, leading to significant improvements in operational efficiency and client satisfaction.
